summary: The comment supports continuing the E-Rate program and urges the FCC not to terminate or reduce E-Rate support for public schools. The comment argues that the program has been providing connectivity for thirty years and should continue to do so, as the costs of not providing connectivity would fall on state and local education budgets. The comment emphasizes the importance of preserving reliable internet access for students and educators.

claims.argument: E-Rate program has been providing connectivity for thirty years and should continue to do so
claims.evidence_quote: For thirty years, E-Rate has helped schools provide the connectivity and network infrastructure necessary to educate students. The educational environment has changed dramatically during that time, but that is an argument for preserving reliable connectivity, not abandoning it.
